creation.validation: Validate task details before creation. Ensure all required fields are present and properly formatted.

assignment.notification: You have been assigned a new task. Please review the details and confirm acceptance.

update.validation: Validate task updates. Ensure status transitions are valid and progress is accurately reported.

completion.validation: Verify that all acceptance criteria are met before marking task as complete.

prioritization.urgent: Urgent priority - Immediate action required. This task blocks other work or has critical deadline.
prioritization.high: High priority - Important task that should be completed soon. May impact project timeline.
prioritization.medium: Medium priority - Standard task. Should be completed in normal course of work.
prioritization.low: Low priority - Can be deferred without impacting project. Nice-to-have or backlog item.

dependencies.blocking: This task is blocked by: {{blockedBy}}. Resolve dependencies before proceeding.
dependencies.blocked: This task blocks: {{blocks}}. Complete this task to enable dependent work.
dependencies.circular: Warning: Circular dependency detected between tasks {{task1}} and {{task2}}. Resolve to prevent deadlock.
